fixture_name: Cloverleaf-to-urban interchange conversion — INT preliminary design (Wikimedia PD geometry)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Shortened collector-distributor weave carrying 1,100 pcu/h peak-hour demand concentrates lane-change conflicts raising sideswipe/rear-end exposure, a substantive preliminary-design-stage interchange safety issue.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Verbatim EV-IN-004 quote confirms PIARC motorway checklists exist for the preliminary design stage, and the weave geometry and 1,100 pcu/h volume are recorded input facts, grounding the pivotal claim beyond registry citation alone.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Finding remains within the PIARC international preliminary-design framework as a categorical safety concern with no compliance claim conflated; HSM/IHSDM appear only as optional analytical tools, not imported normative requirements.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Recommendation is specific and staged: apply the named PIARC checklist now, quantify with HSM Part C or IHSDM, and conditionally lengthen the weave or add ramp metering, all viable at preliminary design before geometry is fixed.
justifications.vru_coverage: VRUs are not exposed because shared-use paths are grade-separated from the motorised weave, and the finding explicitly acknowledges and scopes this out, matching the not-applicable-but-acknowledged case.

justifications.substance: Uncontrolled free-flow ramp-terminal crossings of retained shared-use paths against explicit corridor VRU-continuity objectives is a substantive preliminary-design safety issue, not vacuous.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Site-specific claims tie to recorded input facts (stated objectives, recorded layout retaining shared-use paths) and EV-IN-005 supplies a verbatim PIARC Ch.10.4 quote directly supporting the all-road-users/VRU-audit basis; no invented content detected.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly filed as a safety_concern rather than a compliance question, applies PIARC/Austroads thematic-audit semantics appropriate to the qualified int:preliminary-design baseline, and keeps the two categories distinct.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and viable at preliminary design: named tools (Walkability Checklist, CQSI), thematic audit application, and concrete treatments (signalised northern loop crossing; signalised or grade-separated crossings at both retained loop terminals).
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are the explicit focus of the finding, with their exposure at each ramp-terminal/path interface directly analysed.
